title: papertowel holder
text: papertowel holder. Purchased this for garage use and installed it standing up.  Works perfectly.  Easy to remove the sheets and easy to replenish with one hand. Easy to install - husband used more sturdy mollies than what came with it, but you can decide on your own what you think.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope my review was helpful to you.

description: Seeking a modern alternative to the traditional paper towel holder? Look no further then this kitchen paper towel holder. Introducing Cappa Wall Mounted Paper Towel Holder by UmbraThe Cappa Paper Towel Holder embraces a simple and elegant style that gives you the flexibility to mount it in a way that best suits your needs. Cappa can be mounted horizontally under a cabinet or on a wall. If space is limited or you're going for a different look, Cappa is equally effective when mounted vertically to a wall or even the side of a cabinet. Easy to LoadUnlike other paper towel dispensers which have tension arms or oversized end caps that need to be removed in order to reload the paper towels, Cappa was designed so that you can effortlessly slide a new standard-sized paper towel roll on in seconds - it literally couldn't be easier to use. Cappa works with your favorite brand of paper towel and comfortably accomodates standard sized paper towel rolls (and even most popular jumbo-sized rolls). Cappa Paper Towel Holder is available in an elegant nickel finish that works with any decor and measures 14 x 3. 75 x 2. 75 inches. For a modern paper towel dispenser that offers the perfect balance of form and function, order your Cappa Paper Towel Holder today!
